scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,owner,tenant,admin -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w owner-app" "npm run dev -w tenant-app" "npm run dev -w admin-app"
scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w pg-core && npm test -w owner-app && npm test -w tenant-app
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run typecheck -w pg-core && npm run typecheck -w owner-app && npm run typecheck -w tenant-app && npm run typecheck -w admin-app
scripts.build: npm run build -w owner-app && npm run build -w tenant-app && npm run build -w admin-app && npm run build -w backend
